Title: Swiss National Championship, 2 July 2023, in Geneva.

Messages.Author: Pablaux
Messages.Body:
Hello Everyone,

It is my great pleasure to announce that Geneva is hosting the

*** Swiss National Championship 2023 ***
(see the tournament rules, eg no proxy cards)
Version française

Date: Sunday, July 2, 2023
Location: Private house: Carnino Claudia and Martin (my folks)
Address:
16 chemin du Devancet
1214 Vernier (Genève)

Bus stop "Vernier village", Bus #6, or #19.
A. 20 min from the central train station "Cornavin"
B. 20 min from the airport (rides may be organized to get to Vernier since I live 5-10min walk from the airport and the bus trip involves a connexion)

***Schedule***

8h00 - 8h30: Meet, Greet, and register-eet (Coffee, croissants, etc.)
8h45 - 10h45: First round
11h00 - 13h00: Second round
13h00 - 14h30: Lunch break (pizza)
14h45 - 16h45: Third round
16h45 - 17h00: Coffee break
17h15 - 19h45: Final
20h00 - 23h00: BBQ Party and celebration of the new champion! (A Hot tub is available for those that have a flesh of marble.)

***Registration fee***

35 Euros/Swiss Francs, include the following:

- basic registration and contribution to prize pool
- breakfast upon arrival on Sunday (coffee, juice, croissants, etc)
- lunch (pizzas from an italian pizzeria and soft drinks)
- dinner (BBQ and drinks such as beer and soft drinks; those of you who know me well know that I am of Argentine descent, my brother and I will cook for everyone at dawn, it will be worth your while!)
- some light snacking and coffee input will be available all day too, bleeding and being bled can be such a drain!

As I mentioned before, the money will be spent wisely. If you have dietary restrictions or strong preference, please let me know ASAP ( and here:).

The combined spending is considerable and I am not your typical swiss banker, so I'd appreciate payment upfront, with twint: +41 76 693 69 85. Be sure to mention your name so that I know what the payment is for.
If you dont have twint, please send me an email and I will provide my bank information for a transfer.
Naturally, you can also pay cash, here, but if most people do that, I will be in trouble  #notaventrue!

We look forward to sharing a drink and some vtes-related laughs

Cheers,
Pablo, prince of Geneva, Switzerland
PS: Our local vtes legend Ruben Feldman (aka the GOAT) will do us the honor of his presence, and, let's face it, his dominate too.

PSII: Casual warmup games can be organized the day before(Saturday the 1rst, that is). Several players indicated not coming in until Saturday night, such that it didnt make sense to have a warm up tournament, and I like sense just as much as the next guy.)

Messages.Author: Pablaux
Messages.Body:
Heyo! to all the players who will be attending Sunday's tournament (Swiss Championship).

As everyone will be arriving at different times tomorrow, there won't be any specific activities planned. However, if you want to play games or have some drinks, I suggest the following:

Le Brise-Glace, a game bar located under the train station.
L'Usine, an alternative zone in the city center for punk music and drinks.
Café Cuba, in Cirque (you can find it on Google Maps too), a very nice bar with a large table for playing in the afternoon until 7 PM.
Xenomorph, our dedicated game store, in case you want to do some reverse tourism for shopping.

Several members of our playgroup are totally up for playing games or having drinks, so don't hesitate to introduce yourselves or directly contact Pablo (+41 76 693 69 85).

For those who will arrive early, I suggest some tourist activities:

The Jet d'Eau of Geneva (in the game of "who has the biggest," we stand tall).
Les Bastions with the Reformation Wall, because before being harassed by Catholics, Protestants showed off as the cool kids in our parks.
Les Rues Basses if you have Ventrue lineage and want to part with your money for politician watches.

Looking forward to meeting all of you!

Pierre

Messages.Author: Pablaux
Messages.Body:
The day has come and past so quickly that I was barely able to see it.
First of all, I'd like to thank everyone for this great event, my organizing team (they know who they are, in Geneva and beyond) as well as the gracious guests who were always kind and helpful.
Secondly, I'd like to congratulate Marius Iscru, the 2023 Swiss Champion (Obviously, the person holding the trophy in the picture).
